reason: I already get all of this free on YouTube and GeeksforGeeks, and I use a free AI chatbot for doubts, so I have never paid for a study resource and I don't see why I would start with this. The AI mentor and resume checks sound useful, but the free versions cover most of what I need.
objection: If the free tools already cover DSA and DBMS, what does INR 299 a month give me that I can't get for nothing? The 'checked progress' idea sounds good but I can't tell yet if it actually helps me get placed.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, free trial that shows the resume ATS scoring and the mentor are clearly better than what I already use for free, with real results from people in my college.
